title: Design: Invoice shows the no-charge line at $0.00 with the category name
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a regular customer (not flagged), with one asset.
  • Have a new billable work order for the regular customer, not invoiced, with two lines: each with 1.0 h of labor and one stock part with a cost, made for this test.
  • Mark the second line No Charge with the category Warranty.
  • Complete every line.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow6-07-07-invoice-the-line-at-0-00-warranty.png, iwo-happy-35-35-invoice-the-line-at-0-00-warranty.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the billable work order.
  2. Click Create invoice.
  3. Open the invoice preview on the Finance tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens.

Step 2:

  • The invoice is created and shows on the Finance tab.

Step 3:

  • The no-charge line shows its hours and parts at $0.00 with "Warranty" as a line under its title.
  • No stamp, no badge and no "No Charge" wording anywhere on the invoice.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-R7: “Create invoice works as today. The invoice (preview, PDF, email, portal) shows the no-charge line with its hours and parts at $0.00 and the category name as a line under the title ("Warranty"); no stamp, no badge, no "No Charge" wording elsewhere on the document. The invoice statement of the line is priced 0 and flagged no_charge with the category and the original work order, line and technician, the way a declined line's statement is priced 0 today; its items are priced 0. The statement keeps the line's hours and labour rate for the record.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: pages "Flow 6 · Move one line off a billable work order" / "Happy flow v6", boards "07 Invoice · the line at $0.00, Warranty" (Flow 6 · Move one line off a billable work order), "35 Invoice · the line at $0.00, Warranty" (Happy flow v6).
